name: Mystery Miniaturist
source:
Come home to find a dead body in your kitchen. Play detective and have a conversation within your own brain.

A short Disco Elysium-inspired fan-game.

[From [url=https://katy133.itch.io/mystery-miniaturist]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
回到家，却发现厨房里躺着一具尸体。扮演侦探，与自己脑海中的声音展开对话。

一部受《极乐迪斯科》启发的短篇同人游戏。

[摘自[url=https://katy133.itch.io/mystery-miniaturist]Itch.io[/url]]
